title: Code and data for: A Two-Decade Decline in Daytime Land Surface Temperature over Ajmer, Semi-Arid Northwest India
description: Python code, input data subsets (MODIS MOD11A2/MYD11A2, VIIRS VNP21A2, MCD12Q1, MCD12Q2 and ERA5-Land) and tests that reproduce all tables and figures of the associated manuscript: Theil-Sen/Mann-Kendall LST trends, overpass-geometry and clear-sky sampling controls, ERA5-Land comparison at matched overpass time, month-resolved trends, phenology trends and attribution statistics. See README.md for usage.
